description: This line plot illustrates the change in loss over training time for two methods, labeled "Vanilla" and an unnamed method represented by the gray bar in the legend, which appears to be a placeholder or incomplete label. The x-axis represents Training Time in seconds, ranging from 0 to 250,000 seconds, with tick marks at intervals of 50,000 seconds. The y-axis represents Loss, ranging from 2.40 to 2.75, with tick marks at intervals of 0.05. The "Vanilla" method is depicted by a purple line with triangle markers and a solid line style, starting at a loss of approximately 2.75 and decreasing to about 2.50 by the end of the training period. The other method, indicated by a red line with circle markers and a solid line style, begins at a loss of approximately 2.75 and decreases to about 2.50 by the end of training. A green dashed horizontal line marks a loss value of 2.50. A green dashed rectangle highlights the region from approximately 200,000 to 250,000 seconds of training time, with an annotation "1.26×" indicating the ratio of loss values between the two methods at that point, which appears to be around 2.50 for both.
